summary: EL 35 / Hors 1/35 describes the driver going uphill and downhill; i kaše is the route.
before: The slope went up and down
after: (er) die Steigung hinauffuhr und dann wieder hinabfuhr
rationale: The male driver remains subject across naḥət, saləq and kali; the edition says 'Als er hinabfuhr, die Steigung hinauffuhr und dann wieder hinabfuhr'. The replacement is cut from that wording, with the omitted subject supplied in parentheses.

summary: Correct the direction in the causative gloss
rationale: The entry defines slq as to go up, ascend. Stem III examples describe raising Farxo onto the throne, taking someone upstairs, and the bird carrying someone up to his homeland. The adjacent gloss nach oben bringen also confirms upward motion. Hinaussteigen introduces outward motion through an evident one-letter slip.

data.translation: Wenn du dann, wenn sie kommen, weißt, welches der schwarze ist, so mußt du dich Rittlings auf ihn setzen. Er wird dich nach oben bringen. Setzest du dich auf den Rücken des weißen, so wird er dich sieben Stockwerke unter die Erde hinunterbringen. Und dann, sprach sie, kannst du sehen, wie du fertig wirst. -

summary: example for sense 1c in Preterit Intransitive (Jan 1.10/376)

data.turoyo: W kətwo mʕalləm Ṭaləb w kətwo ġer malfone maqranwolan. Bdelan mu ṣənəf du ḥa w hul d saləqina laḥ ḥamšo nafəqina. I naqqa d čəkina bu ṣənəf daḥ ḥamšo, mbadlo Eski Türkçe (tərki ʕatiqo), hawyo Yeni Türkçe (tərki ḥaṯo). Bu ṣənəf daḥ ḥamšo, mbadelan qrelan Yeni Harf (ḥarf ḥaṯo).
data.translation: And there was Teacher Taleb and there were other teachers who used to teach us. We began from the first class, and until we went up to the fifth, we went out. When we entered the fifth class, Eski Türkçe [old Turkish] changed and became Yeni Türkçe [new Turkish]. In the fifth class we changed and studied Yeni Harf [new letters].

rationale: Illustrates the grouped institutional advancement sense. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; meaning is established from the Turoyo.

summary: Remove the stray ich from the clause about the bird
before: und nun will ich mich der Vogel
after: und nun will mich der Vogel
rationale: Der Vogel is the subject and mich the object. The extra ich makes the clause ungrammatical. The edition reads und nun will mich der Vogel nach meiner Heimat hinaufbringen.

summary: Sense 1b: revise the gloss
after: fig. rise in price or on another numerical scale; reach a value, total or age (mit l- + endpoint);
rationale: Round 1 limits 1b to monetary value. Jan 3.17/335 applies the same upward numerical endpoint construction to a total, and Jan 3.3/38 to attained age. Broaden that meaning explicitly rather than multiplying nearly synonymous scalar senses. Monetary uses remain included.

summary: All 68 occurrences and reader notes were checked. The finite and nominal s-l-q forms stay under slq; ysq is a parallel allomorph entry and is not merged or edited here.
Goal coding includes l-, ʕal-, gab-, bwar and implicit goals; i kaše in Hors 1/35 is a zero-marked traversed path. III adds a caused mover, with -o/-i or person suffixes and a separate destination.

ko-Preterit contrasts with k-/g- Infectum; German anterior or finite translations cannot determine the box. Part act. occurs in ritual-status and itinerary contexts. Infectum-wa expresses customary workshop routines and construction.

All sloqo/sloqe attestations are filed provisionally in ordinary Infinitiv. The castle's ascent path does not establish a Detransitive paradigm. The lexical direction 'east' is noted as a boundary item, not promoted to another verb sense.

Existing EL 34, EL 49, prs 9/22, 60/83, 71/76, 77/109 and 69/14 passages overlap these source references; they are not collected a second time. 69/14's attached castle wording differs from the supplied bird passage and needs source collation.

No new light-verb idiom is supported. Rising in monetary value is the only accepted new subsense; physical mounting, solar beauty comparisons, orientated teeth and mobile substances remain within ascent.
Most proposals to fill physical-ascent cells are redundant after round 1: I Preterit Intransitive has six examples, Infectum-wa five, Imperativ five. No further routine physical example is added.
Jan 1.10/376 saləqina laḥ ḥamšo and Jan 2.31/4898 d soləq describe institutional progression; III mtasləq lu darġo names promotion without an expressed promoter.

Numerical totals and attained age generalise the scalar endpoint already proposed in round 1. This round changes the gloss of 1b explicitly; it does not silently assign these uses to a gloss confined to auction prices.
Infectum-wa also describes the static upward extent of a wall and a route; -wa cannot be reduced to habitual action. The theological ascents and seasonal rhymes retain spatial sense 1.
Jan 2.10/2183 saləqatla has an l-suffix referring to a destination, not an additional transitive patient. The source is a brief question and is not chosen over fuller examples.
What ritual status does saliqo du maṯəbḥo denote, and how does d- attach in JTM 1.2/7?
Check maslaqle in JTM 5.3/33: is it an abandoned eye-raising formulation? The translation supplies no separate equivalent; no example is added.
In MAC NI Aḥmad Aġa Oṣman Aġa/53, are the men rising from kneeling or moving to a roof? No new posture sense is inferred.
Confirm agent suffix/gender in masəlqola at 112/96; -la conflicts with Kalaš Ali. Resolve masəlqile at 112/247–248 before publishing it as a definite Infectum example.
Is Aslequllan (PrS 58/40) plural address or another causative form? The translation addresses the horse in the singular.
Lahdo The snake/8 has u samo 'poison' where the English says blood; 115/184's translation includes verse 185. Both translations are withheld from added examples pending alignment review.
Are sloqe sunrise/east nouns lexicalized or productive Infinitiv forms? Is the construction in 93/20 ordinary Infinitiv, as proposed here?
Check the citation-to-example match at 69/14 and old PrS page/line concordances before changing references.

Does editorial policy prefer separate lettered constructions for numerical total and attained age, or is the widened scalar subsense 1b appropriate? Each nonmonetary construction currently has one clear attestation.
Confirm the Detransitive formation mtasləq at Jan 3.4/49, including its citation base forms; the attested Infectum is published without inventing a Preterit partner.
Does Saləq lu ʕumrano have a conventional age-attainment use beyond this biographical passage?

Fire, poison, stones and a hill extend the subject range without changing upward motion or orientation. The architectural example already allows a static subject; human/nonhuman should not become separate numbered senses.
saliqo du maṯəbḥo connects attained ascent to the deceased's ritual status; the exact ecclesiastical status is not determined from the passage.

Jan independently confirms round-1 monetary ascent. The passport cost rises from 4500 to 300000; bread rises from one qurš to ten/twenty. These support the existing proposal rather than establish it again.
Walls extend skyward and roads run uphill. This directly supports round-1 inclusion of inanimate spatial extent without splitting human and nonhuman senses.
